answer_summary: Equating the elementary mass-action rates of steps (1) and (4) and cancelling their common positive [HBrO2] and [H+] factors gives [Br-]_critical = (k1/k4)[BrO3-] = 3/10^7 M, reported as 3.00e-7 mol dm^-3.
assumptions: For each reaction explicitly identified as an elementary step, its rate obeys the standard mass-action rate law.
The common [HBrO2] and [H+] factors are positive at the switching comparison; the problem gives [H+] = 0.8 M and positive fallback [HBrO2] levels for both processes.
